answer: Unpredictable Latency Challenge Routing Each agent registration requires solving a cryptographic puzzle seeded by a fresh atmospheric noise plume sampled every second from public sensors. The network routes validation packets through a dynamic trellis of relay nodes whose exact path is determined by this uncomputable randomness. An attacker attempting to spawn sybil nodes faces a severe gale of network jitter and packet loss. Because the routing topology shifts faster than a computer can precompute alternative paths, duplicate agents experience dropped handshakes.
